- **Total Payments Due by Period**: $13,058 million (Source: [BKR fiscal 2018 annual report (10-K), page 61](documents/report.md))

## Calculation

To determine the total debt and capital lease obligations as a percentage of the total payments due:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Total Debt and Capital Lease Obligations}}{\text{Total Payments Due by Period}} \right) \times 100 \]

- **Total Payments Due by Period**: $13,058 million
- **Percentage of Total Debt and Capital Lease Obligations**: 63.00%
